Thanks again for the time on the call earlier this week. As discussed, we'd like to run a technical deep-dive / architecture review to align on multi-region deployment options and data residency constraints (US / EU / APAC) ahead of the pilot. The session will cover:

- High-level deployment topologies (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Data flow and residency (ingress, storage, KV cache persistence)
- KMS / key separation and audit logging
- Latency & failover strategy across regions
- Action items & mutual timelines

Proposed 90-minute slots (all times in UTC):
- Tue 19 May: 15:00 - 16:30 UTC
- Wed 20 May: 10:00 - 11:30 UTC
- Thu 21 May: 08:00 - 09:30 UTC (better for APAC attendees)

Please let me know which slot works, or propose alternatives. Can you CC the cloud security / legal contacts who will need to attend for residency questions?

Thanks,
